finding: The first supplemental R4 probe equated reading continuity with unchanged raw scrollTop. pa04824d changed180 to185 pixels while its implementation actively anchors the same visible content; compact/expanded content top padding changes from27 to32 pixels.
correction: Accept either retained valid scrollTop (within2px, with scroll-range clamping) OR a retained visible content landmark (within2px relative to the reading viewport). Record both measurements. This covers the two legitimate continuity mechanisms without editing any app.
applied_to: Every T3 output. The three already observed outputs are rerun uniformly with the corrected probe; the fourth will use the corrected probe.
original_observations: contract-supplement-history/raw-offset-v1/<run>/ preserves all three original complete probe runs, including the180→185 false failure.
scope: Functional continuity equivalence, not an aesthetic score or precise semantic reading-comprehension measurement; the measured content landmarks and limitations stay visible.
